caption:
AI should take the admin off your plate. Communities stay human. 🧡

Nick from our product team on why Pulse, Heartbeat's built-in AI assistant, is admin-facing only: it helps you build and manage your community so you can spend your time actually engaging in it.

Online and in-person spaces are meant for humans, and we're holding that line.

Follow for more community ideas.
